web_search.radient.access.note: access column for the Radient search provider; 'Radient' is a product name, never translated

web_search.radient.detail.note: one-line description of the Radient search provider row. Keep 'Tavily', 'Radient', '$0.01' and the backticked command verbatim.

web_search.radient.credits_low.role: web_search failure reason shown in the tool card and returned to the model (rendered in English for the model; translated for display)
web_search.radient.credits_low.note: Keep 'Radient', 'Radient Console' and the backticked command verbatim.

web_search.radient.sign_in_again.role: web_search failure reason shown in the tool card and returned to the model (rendered in English for the model; translated for display)
web_search.radient.sign_in_again.note: Keep 'Radient', 'Radient Console' and the backticked command verbatim.

web_search.radient.not_signed_in.role: web_search failure reason shown in the tool card and returned to the model (rendered in English for the model; translated for display)
web_search.radient.not_signed_in.note: Keep 'Radient', 'Radient Console' and the backticked command verbatim.

web_search.state.auto_radient.role: provider state word in `lop search list` and `/search`
web_search.state.auto_radient.tone: terse lowercase status word, matches existing words like 'auto free' / 'auto paid'
web_search.state.auto_radient.note: a short state word, shown in a 16-cell column; 'Radient' is a product name. 'native' means the model vendor's own built-in web search.

web_search.meaning.auto_radient.role: legend explaining a state word in `lop search list` and `/search`
web_search.meaning.auto_radient.tone: terse lowercase clause, no final period
web_search.meaning.auto_radient.note: explains what the state word means for the user's next search; 'Radient' is a product name; 'legs' are steps of the search fallback chain.

web_search.marker.plan.role: marker after a provider name in the `chain:` line
web_search.marker.plan.note: '(plan)' = included in a subscription the user already pays for; '(credits)' = billed to Radient credits. Keep the parentheses.

web_search.marker.credits.role: marker after a provider name in the `chain:` line
web_search.marker.credits.note: '(plan)' = included in a subscription the user already pays for; '(credits)' = billed to Radient credits. Keep the parentheses.
